To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
anomalies and R-R charges are dual to one another and that NS-NS tadpole cancellation and RG flows are also dual to one another.

(a) anomalies and tadpoles are related by open/closed duality, (b) tadpoles can be computed by a non-perturbative RG flow, and (c) the RG flow can be computed by tadpoles in an open/closed dually equivalent theory.
the anomaly cancellation condition is equivalent to the cancellation of RR tadpoles, and that RG-flows in the open sector are related to NS-NS tadpole cancellation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: 1.
the study of anomalies, RG flows and string dualities in open string theories.
the interplay between anomalies and tadpoles, and the interplay between open and closed string physics.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
anomalies, RG flows and tadpoles are all different aspects of the same physical phenomenon.
anomalies, tadpoles and renormalization group flows are all different manifestations of the same underlying phenomenon, namely, the breaking of conformal symmetry.
anomalies, RG flows and tadpoles are all related to the same phenomenon: open / closed string non-triviality.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
anomalies are the IR manifestation of UV divergences.
the anomalies in the open string spectrum and the R-R tadpole cancellation conditions are equivalent.
open/closed duality is the natural framework in which the interplay of UV and IR divergences is understood.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the anomaly cancellation condition in the open string sector is a necessary and sufficient condition to avoid IR divergences, and that tadpole cancellation conditions in the unoriented sector are necessary and sufficient to avoid RG flows.
anomalies are not just a UV phenomenon, but they are intimately related to the IR physics of string vacua.
the presence of tadpoles is a necessary condition to ensure the absence of anomalies.
